correctness.rationale: For T_f(a,b)=(f(a,b),f(b,a)), multiplication f◁g corresponds exactly to function composition T_g ∘ T_f. Each tau-equivariant T on X² comes from a unique binary operation f. Stationarity of consecutive powers is equivalent to every directed cycle being a fixed point; stabilized commutativity requires its image to lie on diagonal D, hence all cycles are diagonal fixed roots. Choose r such roots in C(n,r) ways. The diagonal map is a fixed-root directed forest counted by r*n^(n-r-1), with r=n boundary value 1. Each of the m=C(n,2) free flip-pair orbits points to a diagonal target with weight 1 or to another free orbit with weight 2, with no directed cycles. The weighted forest Laplacian (n+2m)I_m-2J_m has determinant n(n+2m)^(m-1)=n(n²)^(m-1). Independent diagonal and free-orbit choices give C(n,r) r n^(n²-r-2). Summation and normalization yield the binomial law and Poisson limit; all nonroot forest vertices form a path of length n+m-r in a sharp example. Independent defining-power enumeration of all 16 n=2 and 19,683 n=3 magma operations recovered rank counts (4,2), (2187,1458,243); these finite enumerations do not prove general n.
